title: Chrono-Arcana Sapphire & Brass Corset Gown

The rich sapphire velvet pleats drape and sway softly while warm studio light catches the burnished brass filigree at her waist, and she eases smoothly back into her starting pose. Locked static camera, clean solid white studio backdrop, no floating text or overlays.
